ELITE 2026-06-20 (v0.8.0): net-new elite-technical-geo-2026.md. GATE-0 vs already-held (GEO page-scoring rubric in aeo-ai-visibility.md; live GSC/DataForSEO/scraper in live-search-data-tooling.md): three genuinely net-new layers absorbed as METHODOLOGY. (1) GEO citation-MEASUREMENT framework - fixed prompt panel (30-100 bucketed buyer queries) + citation rate / mention rate / citation share / share-of-voice + answer-vs-citation sentiment + cited-source attribution; rubric scores the page (cause), panel measures citations (effect). Sourced from 2026 GEO-measurement literature (arXiv 2604.25707 Citation Selection->Absorption + industry citation-metric frameworks). (2) Server log-file analysis + crawl-budget recovery - IP-based bot verification (never user-agent; reverse-DNS + operator IP-JSON, an AI crawler IP-list-only), crawl-by-template waste recovery, status-code discipline (410>404, never noindex for crawl budget, 503 suppresses crawl), and the three-way AI-crawler split (indexation/training/retrieval) as a per-bot robots.txt decision. (3) Entity-SEO / topical-authority depth - entity establishment+disambiguation in the Knowledge Graph + topical-authority-as-entity-coverage mapping, deepening the existing multi-property @id/sameAs rule. Wired into rules.md (4 decision rules + ref), SKILL.md (References table), seo-audit-6-phase.md (Phase 1 log analysis + Phase 5 citation panel). CONNECT/host-wiring: server log access (Cloudflare Logpush/Botify/Lumar or raw logs) + Screaming Frog Log File Analyser for the technical tier; optional paid GEO panel-runner (Profound/Peec/Ahrefs Brand Radar/Semrush) for automated citation panels (cost-approval, same posture as DataForSEO). No em-dashes; one net-new registered reference.
